whyProfessional.title: Why Professional Carpet Cleaning?
whyProfessional.subtitle: Carpets hold far more dust and grit than they show. Here is why professional carpet cleaning is worth doing once or twice a year:

points.title: Grit Out of the Pile
points.desc: Grit cuts carpet fibres from below; dusting and extraction remove it.

points.title: Allergens Removed
points.desc: Dust, mites and pet dander are cleaned out, not just vacuumed from the surface.

points.title: Colours Revived
points.desc: A deep clean lifts the grey film that dulls colour over time.

points.title: Dried Properly
points.desc: Complete drying avoids the damp smell of a carpet washed at home.

points.title: Backing Protected
points.desc: Fibre and backing are assessed so the carpet keeps its shape.

points.title: No Mess at Home
points.desc: We take it away and bring it back; nothing is soaked on your floor.

stainTreatment.title: Tough Stains? We Treat Them Before the Deep Clean.
stainTreatment.subtitle: These are the marks we see most often on carpets & rugs. Each one is assessed and pre-treated before the main clean.

faqs.q: How much does carpet cleaning cost at Wash4You?
faqs.a: Carpet cleaning starts from {price1} per square foot. Prices are exclusive of 18% GST, and pickup and delivery are free.

faqs.q: How long does carpet cleaning take?
faqs.a: Carpet cleaning takes about 48 hours, including complete drying.

faqs.q: Do I need to measure my carpet before booking?
faqs.a: It helps. Tell us the approximate size when you book and we will give you an estimate; the carpet is measured again at pickup and the final price confirmed before cleaning.

faqs.q: Can you remove stains from carpets & rugs?
faqs.a: Visible stains are identified and pre-treated before the main clean. Results depend on the type and age of the stain, the fabric and any earlier home treatment, so complete removal cannot be guaranteed for every mark.
